decisions.reason: The citrus harvesting crate was a flagship serving a steady agricultural niche, and harvest crates have long product lifecycles, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some uncertainty.
Foldable large containers are a core reusable packaging category with several models, so the firm is likely to keep the line despite it not being seen on the website recently.
Stackable crates are a staple, low-cost line for food, retail and pooling customers and are rarely discontinued, even if they get less website visibility.
A medium-duty rackable pallet fills a standard gap in the pallet range, but its absence from the website in 2020–2021 raises the risk that it has been merged into other lines.

Spill-retention pallets are a niche industrial line with several models; it was not seen on the website after 2019, which raises the risk somewhat, but niche safety products tend to stay in the catalogue.
As a single specialized pallet variant not seen on the website since 2019, it carries the highest drop risk, but low upkeep cost makes keeping it more likely.
